boundary: Declare → Verify → Consume → Execute. Never Install → Connect → Authenticate → Configure.

prerequisites.required_runtime: opencode | claude-code | codex | copilot-cli | antigravity | cursor | gemini-cli | aider | generic-command
prerequisites.verification: read-only executable presence + version probe; never install, login, or configure
prerequisites.notes: How the runtime is installed belongs to the operator/runtime. AIW only verifies availability and consumes the existing connection.

prerequisites.verification: delegated redacted status only (authenticated/unauthenticated); raw secrets never handled
prerequisites.notes: AIW declares that a capability requires an authenticated runtime and consumes values already provided by the environment. It never generates, requests, stores, rotates, logs in with, or configures credentials.
